maria (PM): @eng-ml FYI we received a new customer onboarding request for Lynx-13B from Greenfield Health. They want Private deployment (VPC) + int4 quantization, p95 latency target <220ms for short prompts, throughput ~150 req/s, and HIPAA-style controls. Can someone triage? Form: https://forms.internal/greenfield-onboard :eyes:

sam (ML Eng): Ack. I'll take lead on the model side. Quick checklist in my head: 1) tokenizer compat 2) model config & dtype 3) checkpoint sharding 4) quant sweep & eval harness 5) rollout plan.

jordan (Runtime): Notes: int4 path may hit kernel fallbacks depending on hw. Need to know target infra (A100 vs H100) and whether we can test both. Also kv-cache tuning for short prompt latency.

maria (PM): Customer prefers Dedicated A100s in us-east initially, but can switch to H100 if perf requires it. They'll need VPC + KMS.

ops-bot: Intake created: ticket #INC-4821 assigned to @sam. SLA: 5 business days.

jordan (Runtime): Suggest quant candidates: q4f, nf4, q8_0. If accuracy delta >4% vs fp16 on clinical QA, fallback to int8. Plan a canary rollout: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if regression.

sam (ML Eng): I'll run a quant sweep (q4f, q4_0, nf4) and report accuracy + latency by EOD tomorrow. Need sample customer prompts (~200 de-identified + 20 edge cases). Also need tokenizer files and model weights access.

maria (PM): I'll request the prompt bundle and confirm retention/PII rules with the customer. Also will ask them to confirm avg token length and peak concurrency.
